title: Ghislaine Maxwell Trial & Conviction
summary: S.D.N.Y. trial Nov 29–Dec 29, 2021: four accuser witnesses testified under oath to grooming and sexual abuse as minors with Maxwell's assistance; exhibits included flight logs, the address book, photographs and financial records. Guilty on 5 of 6 counts; sentenced June 2022 to 20 years; affirmed by the Second Circuit (2024); Supreme Court declined review (Oct 2025). Note: trafficking of victims TO third parties was not proven at trial and remains alleged, not established.
tldr: A federal jury convicted Ghislaine Maxwell on Dec 29, 2021 of sex trafficking a minor and related conspiracies; on June 28, 2022 she was sentenced to 20 years in prison plus a $750,000 fine for a decade-long scheme (1994-2004) grooming girls as young as 14 for Epstein.
ai_summary:
AI review of the DOJ SDNY sentencing press release (June 28, 2022), read in full:
- Conviction: guilty Dec 29, 2021 after a one-month jury trial — conspiracy to entice minors, conspiracy to transport minors, transporting a minor, sex-trafficking conspiracy, and sex trafficking of a minor.
- Sentence: 240 months (20 years) by Judge Alison J. Nathan, plus 5 years supervised release and a $750,000 fine.
- Conduct (1994-2004): Maxwell 'assisted, facilitated, and participated' in Epstein's abuse of minor girls — recruiting, grooming, normalizing abuse (discussing sexual topics, undressing in front of victims), being present for sex acts, and in some instances participating directly. Victims as young as 14.
- Method: befriending victims (movies, shopping trips), offering travel/education help to create indebtedness, paying victims hundreds in cash per encounter, and paying victims to recruit additional girls — 'a network of underage victims.'
- Locations: Epstein's residences in New York, Florida, New Mexico, and Maxwell's London residence. Record summary verified accurate against the document.
